headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to look for ways to make birth control and family planning services more affordable and easier to get.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Biden on June 23, 2023, focuses on access to contraception (birth control) and family planning services. Based on its title, it aims to make these services more affordable and of higher quality. Executive orders like this usually direct federal agencies to take or consider actions, but no summary was provided, so the specific steps are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People who use or want birth control
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at making contraception more affordable and easier to get.

who_it_affects.group: People who use family planning services
who_it_affects.how: The order seeks to improve access to and quality of these services.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that oversee health programs
who_it_affects.how: Agencies would likely be directed to take or consider steps to expand access, though the details are not provided here.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 23, 2023; executive orders generally take effect when signed, though any agency actions may come later.
